LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_XSpeedFirstStrik:
Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's SPEED in battle.
That will help it get in the first strike--a decided advantage!
LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOn:
On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local specialty that you can buy only there.
Give it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.
